# Secret content

Content does not carry a high-confidence secret. The check scans for structured
secret patterns (cloud access keys, provider tokens, PEM private-key blocks, and
realistic JWTs), each pattern requiring enough structural detail to avoid matching
documentation prose; a match is redacted to its first twelve characters in the
finding so the check output never echoes a full value. Lines inside fenced code
blocks are skipped, and at most one finding is reported per line. The
secret-pattern vocabulary is fixed in the check implementation; the scanned-suffix
set and the exempt-file set (files that document the secret formats by design,
including the check's own source) are project configuration. Content matching no
pattern contributes no findings.
